name: transitions/default
description: A single plot whose curve can animate between waveforms; the screenshot shows its settled initial waveform. Judge only content inside the plot; ignore the Morph and Draw buttons, duration and easing controls, headings, descriptions, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: One large plot is visible with its axes, grid, and curve. Do not evaluate the buttons, controls, or other content outside the plot.

A single smooth sine-like wave is fully drawn across the plot, rising to a crest, falling to a trough, and rising again toward the right edge, where it is clipped by the plot border by design. Do not judge exact crest or trough positions or the start value. Fail only if the curve is missing, partly drawn, or clearly not a smooth wave.

Within the plot, axis titles and tick labels are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plot. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.

The plot, grid, ticks, curve, and plot text are visually distinguishable, and no plot element is blank or corrupted. The curve ending abruptly at the right plot border is expected. Vertical-axis tick labels sit close to the left edge of the plot panel by design; fail only if label digits are visibly missing or unreadable.
